A few months ago I posted here that AI access is easy and governance is the next problem. That thread turned into 70+ comments, and honestly, it shaped our roadmap.

"Governance is the part everyone skips until the bill surprises them"

People using AI outside official tools (shadow AI)

We re live on Product Hunt today with the new Intrascope update.

Intrascope started as a BYOK workspace for teams using multiple AI models.

Now we re adding managed AI usage as well, so companies can access top AI models without managing separate API keys, vendor accounts or billing dashboards.

After launching Intrascope and finishing Top 10 Product of the Day, we wanted to open a quick discussion.

The biggest takeaway for us wasn t the ranking, but the conversations. We talked to teams who are already using AI daily and are struggling with scattered tools, separate API keys, lost context, and costs growing without visibility.

That s exactly why we built Intrascope: a shared AI workspace where teams bring their own API keys, work with shared context and Manifests, and keep usage and costs predictable.

Hey Product Hunt 👋 Vladimir here, co-founder of Intrascope.

You may remember us from our last launch (#5 Product of the Week in SaaS, thank you!). Since then 170+ companies have used Intrascope, and they all told us the same thing:

"Love having every model in one place. Now give us our own tools, our own knowledge, and even tighter control over cost."

So we rebuilt Intrascope from the ground up. Today we're launching Intrascope 2.0.

• 120+ models, incl. Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6, Gemini, Grok 4.20, Qwen 3.8, Kimi, DeepSeek• Smart routing: pick "Auto" and the agent chooses the right model for each task, so simple questions never burn premium tokens• Agentic answers that use your company context: Manifests, project files, web search and your connected apps• 1,650+ connectors (Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce...). Admins decide which apps the company can use, people connect with their own permissions• Skills: built-in playbooks plus your own, triggered with "/"• Limits and budgets per company, team, project and person• Smarter context control that trims tokens on every request• A completely new design

For larger orgs: private deployments (VPC or on-prem), custom RAG over internal knowledge, local LLMs/SLMs next to public models, and a white-label edition for telcos and universities.

Why we care: most companies pay for 4 to 6 AI subscriptions and still can't answer "who used what, and what did it cost?" Intrascope gives people freedom and gives the company one view, one budget and one bill.

🎁 PH community: grab the exclusive Product Hunt offer on this page and start your free 7-day trial (no card needed) at portal.intrascope.app.

Would you trust Auto routing, or do you always pick the model yourself?

Which connector should we make deeper first?

The whole team (Jakov, Stefan, Mihajlo and me) is here all day. Ask us anything!

Weboldal: https://intrascope.app
